description.narrative: Projects to enhance institutional and community resilience to address water related risks

title.narrative: Number of countries in which RCRC Movement actors were supported in preparation for or response to crisis

description.narrative: Number of countries in which RCRC Movement actors (National Societies (NS), IFRC/ICRC/PNS delegations) were supported in preparation for or response to crisis

comment.narrative: 2022 & 2023: CASH4WASH Mali project, this project was finalized in 2023. Therefore this number is put on 1. 2022 & 2023: Creating local capacity on Solarized Water Powered Systems project. In 2022, 11 participants from 9 NS (Kenya Red Cross, Somalia Red Crescent, Zambia, Malawi Red Cross, Uganda Red Cross, Siera Leone Red Cross, Ethiopia Red Cross, South Sudan Red Crescent and Sudan Red Crescent) received a training on solarization. In 2023, 6 participants from 6 NS (Ethiopia Red Cross, Zambia Red Cross, Sudan Red Crescent and South Sudan Red Cross, Lebanese Red Cross and NLRC). Therefore the number for 2022 and 2023 is 11 NS (without duplication). 2022 & 2023: Ghana Urban WASH project, this project was finalized in 2023. Therefore this number is put on 1. 2022 & 2023: Partnering for flood resilience water management project, this project was finalized in 2023. Therefore this number is put on 1. 2022 & 2023: Piloting Sustainable Water Management Practices in Zambia project, this project was finalized in 2023. Therefore this number is put on 1. 2022 & 2023: CASH4WASH Sudan project, this project was finalized in 2023. Therefore this number is put on 1. 2022 & 2023: Increasing local capacity in FSM project. Uganda Red Cross and Sudan Red Crescent received support through the purchase of equipment. Key WASH staff will build experience regarding the equipment, however no direct training and / or capacity strengthening was included in this project. This was financed via another project. Therefore this has been put on 0.
